title: Pure Zombie World
summary: The Zombie World control strategy revolves around the Field Spell Zombie World—which turns every monster on the field and in both GYs into a Zombie monster and locks your opponent out of Tribute Summoning non-Zombies—paired with its ultimate boss, Doomking Balerdroch! Normal Summon Uni-Zombie to send Glow-Up Bloom and Necroworld Banshee from your Deck to the GY. Banish Necroworld Banshee from your GY as a Quick Effect to activate Zombie World directly from your Deck, then banish Glow-Up Bloom from your GY—which checks that Zombie World is in your Field Zone and immediately Special Summons the 2800 ATK Doomking Balerdroch directly from your Deck! Because Zombie World turns all of your opponent's monsters on the field and in the GY into Zombies, every single monster effect your opponent activates triggers Doomking Balerdroch to BOTH negate that effect AND banish 1 monster from the field or GY without targeting, while Super Polymerization fuses any 2 of their Zombie-turned monsters into Dragonecro Nethersoul Dragon!

allow.Mezuki: Core Level 4 EARTH Zombie that banishes itself from your GY to Special Summon any Zombie monster from your GY (including Doomking Balerdroch, Uni-Zombie, or Necroworld Banshee!).
allow.Gozuki: Level 4 EARTH Zombie that sends Glow-Up Bloom, Necroworld Banshee, or Mezuki from your Deck to the GY once per turn.
allow.Alghoul Mazera: Level 8 EARTH Zombie (2800 ATK; can be Special Summoned directly from your Deck by Glow-Up Bloom while Zombie World is active!) that banishes itself from your hand or GY if a Zombie monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect instead, and then immediately Special Summons itself!
allow.Super Polymerization: Because Zombie World turns ALL face-up monsters on the field into Zombie monsters, Super Polymerization can fuse ANY 2 of your opponent's face-up monsters into Dragonecro Nethersoul Dragon ('2 Zombie-Type monsters') at Spell Speed 4!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Glow-Up Bloom, Necroworld Banshee, or Mezuki directly from your Deck to the GY.
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards a Zombie to Special Summon Level 1 Glow-Up Bloom directly from your Deck (then link it into Linkuriboh to summon Doomking Balerdroch from your Deck!).
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: adds 'Zombie World' directly from your Deck to your hand.
allow.Dragonecro Nethersoul Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon Fusion ('2 Zombie-Type monsters'; 3000 ATK): summoned via Super Polymerization using ANY 2 of your opponent's monsters while Zombie World is on the field!
allow.Immortal Dragon: Level 6 DARK Zombie Synchro Tuner (made with Uni-Zombie + a Level 3/4) that sends Glow-Up Bloom, Necroworld Banshee, or Mezuki from your Deck to the GY to adjust its Level and climb into Skeletal Dragon Felgrand or Red-Eyes Zombie Dragon Lord!
allow.Skeletal Dragon Felgrand: Level 8 LIGHT Zombie Synchro that banishes a monster on Summon and negates a monster when Doomking Balerdroch revives during the Standby Phase!
allow.Vampire Sucker: Link-2 DARK Zombie that draws 1 card during every Standby Phase when Doomking Balerdroch revives itself from your GY! (Plus, its effect to revive a monster from your opponent's GY to their field as a Zombie lets you Tribute their revived monster or trigger Balerdroch!).
allow.Avendread Savior: Link-2 DARK Zombie that sends Doomking Balerdroch, Necroworld Banshee, or Glow-Up Bloom from your Deck to the GY for cost during battle to weaken an opponent's monster!
allow.Linkuriboh: Link-1 Cyberse monster that links off a Normal/Special Summoned Level 1 Glow-Up Bloom so Bloom's GY effect immediately triggers to summon Doomking Balerdroch from your Deck!

main: Doomking Balerdroch

Signature Level 8 DARK Zombie boss (2800 ATK / 2000 DEF): during the Standby Phase, if a face-up card is in a Field Zone ('Zombie World'!) and this card is in your GY, Special Summons itself in Defense Position; once per Chain, when a Zombie monster (which is EVERY monster on the field or in the GYs under Zombie World!) activates its effect, you can apply 1 of these effects (but not that same effect of Doomking Balerdroch again this turn—so you can apply BOTH once each turn!): ● Negate that effect, ● Banish 1 monster from the field or GY (without targeting)!
Necroworld Banshee

Core Level 4 DARK Zombie engine (1800 ATK): 'Zombie World' in the Field Zone cannot be destroyed by card effects, also neither player can target it with card effects; Quick Effect from your field OR GY to banish this card and activate 1 'Zombie World' directly from your hand or Deck!
Glow-Up Bloom

Core Level 1 DARK Zombie Tuner: if this card is sent to the GY, banishes itself from your GY to add 1 Level 5 or higher Zombie monster ('Doomking Balerdroch' or 'Alghoul Mazera'!) from your Deck to your hand—OR, if 'Zombie World' is in your Field Zone, you can Special Summon it directly from your Deck instead!
Uni-Zombie

Core Level 3 DARK Zombie Tuner starter: discards 1 card to increase a monster's Level by 1, AND sends 1 Zombie monster ('Glow-Up Bloom', 'Necroworld Banshee', or 'Mezuki'!) directly from your Deck to the GY to increase a monster's Level by 1!
Mezuki
Core Level 4 EARTH Zombie extender: banishes itself from your GY to target 1 Zombie monster in your GY and Special Summon it (and while Zombie World is active, EVERY monster in your GY is a Zombie!).
Gozuki
Level 4 EARTH Zombie: sends 1 Zombie monster from your Deck to the GY during your Main Phase, and banishes a Zombie from your GY when sent to the GY to Special Summon a Zombie from your hand.
Alghoul Mazera

Level 8 EARTH Zombie (2800 ATK): if a Zombie monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, banishes this card from your hand or GY instead, and then Special Summons this banished card in Defense Position!
Zombie World

Iconic Field Spell: all monsters on the field and in the GYs become Zombie monsters (turning every opponent's monster on the field/GY into a trigger for Doomking Balerdroch and a valid material for Super Polymerization!); neither player can Tribute Summon monsters, except Zombie monsters!
Super Polymerization
Unrespondable Quick-Play Spell: while Zombie World is on the field, fuses ANY 2 face-up monsters your opponent controls into Dragonecro Nethersoul Dragon!
Zombie Necronize

Normal Spell/Trap: while a Level 5 or higher Zombie monster (Doomking Balerdroch!) is on the field, targets 1 monster your opponent controls and takes permanent control of it until the End Phase; and shuffles 1 of your banished Zombies into the Deck to Set itself from the GY!
Return of the Zombies

Normal Trap: banishes 1 Zombie monster on the field (including any opponent's monster turned into a Zombie by Zombie World!) to Special Summon 1 Zombie from that player's GY to their field in Defense Position; shuffles a banished Zombie into the Deck to Set itself from the GY!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Glow-Up Bloom or Necroworld Banshee from your Deck to the GY.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 1 Glow-Up Bloom from your Deck to link into Linkuriboh and summon Doomking Balerdroch from your Deck.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Zombie World.
extra: Level 8 DARK Dragon Fusion ('2 Zombie-Type monsters'; 3000 ATK): summoned via Super Polymerization using ANY 2 of your opponent's face-up monsters while Zombie World is on the field; reduces any monster it battles to 0 ATK and spawns a Dark Soul Token with that monster's original Level and ATK!

Level 10 DARK Zombie Synchro boss (1 Zombie Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners): Quick Effect during your opponent's turn to Special Summon any Zombie (Doomking Balerdroch, Necroworld Banshee, or Skeletal Dragon Felgrand!) from your GY; and banishes a Zombie you control to revive itself from your GY!
Level 8 LIGHT Zombie Synchro: banishes a monster your opponent controls or in their GY on Special Summon, and negates a face-up monster whenever Doomking Balerdroch revives during the Standby Phase!

Level 7 DARK Zombie Synchro: gains 100 ATK/DEF for every Zombie on the field and in the GYs (which is EVERY monster on the field and in both GYs under Zombie World!) and revives a Zombie from either GY when a Zombie is destroyed by battle!

Level 6 DARK Zombie Synchro Tuner: sends Glow-Up Bloom, Necroworld Banshee, or Mezuki from your Deck to the GY to adjust its Level and climb into Level 8 Felgrand or Level 10 Red-Eyes Zombie Dragon Lord!

Link-2 DARK Zombie: draws 1 card every Standby Phase when Doomking Balerdroch revives itself from your GY, and revives a monster from the opponent's GY to their field in Defense Position (triggering Balerdroch's draw/banish!).
Link-2 DARK Zombie that sends Glow-Up Bloom or Balerdroch from your Deck to the GY during damage calculation.
Link-1 monster that links off Level 1 Glow-Up Bloom to immediately trigger Bloom's GY effect to Special Summon Doomking Balerdroch from your Deck.
